safetyMessage: Rootd System Customizer is the launcher. Use package scans, public settings shortcuts, reports, safe-disable, and systemless profiles first. Advanced features must stay labelled until tested on the exact phone and ROM.
changelog: Added Rootd System Customizer as the launcher activity.
Added Rootd profiles for systemless mode, overlay staging, device matching, safe-disable, rollback, LSPosed scope check, report export, and blocked direct partition changes.

Added system target scan cards for Android Framework, System UI, Settings UI, Launcher, OPlus UX, Battery, Eye Comfort, Notification Manager, OTA, Live Wallpaper Picker, LSPosed, Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch.
Added copy/share Rootd system report actions.
Kept customer customization center and advanced dashboard available inside the app.
